However, it missed the deeper root cause: that the referenced project is likely not part of the solution, which is why it gets built with the wrong configuration. The fix suggestion is in the right direction but not precise enough. The investigation was efficient with good tool usage, but the final diagnosis stops one level short of the true root cause.
